decisive_items: Real-time PCR of lung and heart tissue: Positive for influenza A (H3N2) virus, negative for influenza B virus and 16 other common respiratory viruses
Patchy infiltrates in the upper and middle lobes of the right lung
Oxygen saturation: 86% on room air, 96% on 10L oxygen
response.rationale: PCR confirms influenza A (H3N2) as the definitive etiology; respiratory failure and ARDS are downstream complications, while preeclampsia is unsupported by proteinuria or other criteria.

rejected.why: ARDS is a syndrome/complication of the influenza pneumonia, not the primary diagnosis.
Hypertension alone without proteinuria or other preeclampsia features is insufficient.
Respiratory failure is a consequence of the pneumonia, not the underlying cause.
